newsitem.title: USA: Phycor files for 6.4 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Phycor files for 6.4 mln shr offering.

text.p: PhyCor Inc said on Wednesday that it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a public offering of 6.4 million shares of common stock.
The company said that it would use net proceeds from the offering, expected to be about $200.7 million, to repay bank debt.
Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Equitable Securities Corp, Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc, Piper Jaffray Inc and Salomon Brothers Inc agreed to serve as underwriters in the offering.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option. If exercised, PhyCor may sell up to an additional 895,000 shares of common stock, and 65,000 shares may be sold by certain selling shareholders.
PhyCor is a physician practice management company that operates multi-specialty clinics and manages independent practice associations
